mobile.settings.text_size.label.note: Visible label and accessible name of the Settings control that chooses the app's text size (System, 100%, 150%, 200%). "Text size" means how large the app draws its type, not a font. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.caption_forced.note: Caption under the mode control while it is forced to one side. {name} is a theme NAME (proper noun, never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.caption_system.note: Caption under the mode control while it follows the phone. {light} and {dark} are theme NAMES (proper nouns such as "Dracula", never translated). Says which theme shows in each phone mode. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_dark.note: Screen-reader name of a theme card that is not selected. {name} is the theme NAME (proper noun, never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_dark_selected.note: Screen-reader name of the SELECTED dark theme card. {name} is the theme NAME (never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_light.note: Screen-reader name of a light theme card that is not selected. {name} is the theme NAME (never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.card_light_selecte.note: Screen-reader name of the SELECTED light theme card. {name} is the theme NAME (never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_dark.note: Option: always use the dark side (a dark theme). Keep short; it shares a row with two other options.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_label.note: Accessible name of the three-way control that chooses whether the app follows the phone's light/dark setting or forces one. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_light.note: Option: always use the light side (a light theme). Keep short; it shares a row with two other options.

mobile.settings.theme.mode_system.note: Option: follow the phone's own light/dark setting. Keep short (one word if possible); it shares a row with two other options.

mobile.settings.theme.no_match.note: Shown in a section when the search matches no theme in it. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.row_label.note: Screen-reader name of the Settings row that opens the Theme screen; {name} is the theme painting the app now (a proper noun, never translated). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.search_label.note: Accessible name of the search field that filters the theme list by name. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.search_placeholder.note: Placeholder inside the same search field. Usually identical to the field's accessible name. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.section_dark.note: Section heading over the grid of dark themes. {count} is how many dark themes the section currently lists (after search). Rendered in uppercase in some scripts. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.section_light.note: Section heading over the grid of light themes. {count} is how many light themes the section currently lists (after search). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.theme.title.note: Title of the Theme screen and the label of the Settings row that opens it. "Theme" means a colour scheme for the whole app. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.screen_title.note: Title of the Settings screen header. One word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.section.connection.note: Section header on Settings above the connection status and the computers list. One word.

mobile.settings.section.appearance.note: Section header on Settings above the theme and text-size controls. One word.

mobile.settings.section.about.note: Section header on Settings above the app version and the open-source note. One word.

mobile.settings.account.signed_in.note: Accessible name of the account avatar on the Settings account card; read by a screen reader, never drawn. Short.

mobile.settings.connection.status.note: Small row label left of the connection state pill on Settings. One word, no colon.

mobile.settings.connection.computers.note: Small label above the list of computers on this account in Settings. Plural noun, no colon.

mobile.settings.connection.use.note: Small button on a Settings computer row that switches to that computer. One short verb; it sits in a narrow row.

mobile.settings.connection.refresh.note: Quiet button under the Settings computers list that re-reads the account's computers. One verb.

mobile.settings.about.version.note: Label of the diagnostic row that shows the app's version number to its right. One word.

mobile.settings.about.blurb.note: Plain-language data note at the end of Settings. 'Local Operator', 'Team Bridge' and 'Radient' are product names; 'MIT' is a licence name; 'relay' is the product's word for the program on the user's computer.

mobile.settings.account.delete.note: Quiet button on Settings that opens the Radient console in the browser, where the account is deleted. Radient is a product name.

mobile.settings.account.delete_help.note: Explanation under the delete-account button: deletion happens in the browser, removes the account and its tunnels, and does not touch sessions on the user's computer. Radient is a product name; 'tunnel' is the product's word for the published route to a computer.

mobile.settings.sign_out.title.note: Title of the confirmation dialog opened by Settings Sign out. A question; keep it short.

mobile.settings.sign_out.body.note: Body of the sign-out confirmation: signing out also ends the session on the control plane, so the tunnel stops accepting this phone, and the user's computer is untouched. 'Control plane' and 'tunnel' are product vocabulary.

mobile.settings.sign_out.confirm.note: Confirm button of the sign-out dialog; it performs the sign-out, so it repeats the Sign out action verb. One or two words, sentence case.

mobile.settings.sign_out.done.note: Toast shown after a successful sign-out, just before the welcome screen. Two short sentences; must fit a toast.

mobile.settings.text_size.following.note: Help line under the text-size control when the app follows the phone's setting. {percent} is a whole number shown with a % sign; preserve the placeholder and the percent sign.

mobile.settings.text_size.overridden.note: Help line under the text-size control when the user has chosen a size that overrides the phone's. {percent} is a whole number shown with a % sign; 'above' points to the control just above.

mobile.settings.section.diagnostics.note: Section header on Settings above the read-only connection facts (route, stream, last error). One word.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.route.note: Label of the diagnostic row naming how the phone reaches the computer (Radient tunnel or direct relay). One word.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.stream.note: Label of the diagnostic row showing the live session stream's health word. One word.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.reason.note: Label of the diagnostic row showing the raw machine reason code behind the connection's health (e.g. `reason: stream_stalled`). One word, no colon. The code itself is never translated.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.last_error.note: Label of the diagnostic row showing the most recent connection error's summary. Two words, no colon.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.route_radien.note: Value of the Route diagnostic row when the phone connects through a Radient tunnel. 'Radient' is a product name.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.route_direct.note: Value of the Route diagnostic row when the phone connects straight to the user's own relay. 'Relay' is the product's word for the program on the computer.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.none.note: Value of a diagnostic row that has nothing to show (no route, no error). One word.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.privacy_note.note: Reassurance under the Settings diagnostics rows: the lines shown never contain secrets or conversation content. One sentence.

mobile.settings.account.not_signed_in.note: Name line of the Settings account card when no Radient account name is known. Radient is the product name; keep it in Latin script. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.account.signed_in_radien.note: Name line of the Settings account card when the phone is signed in with a Radient account but no account name is known. Radient is the product name; keep it in Latin script. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.sign_in_confirm.title.note: Title of the confirmation dialog opened by tapping the signed-out Settings account card while the phone has a working (direct or own-tunnel) connection. A question; keep it short. Radient is the product name; keep it in Latin script.

mobile.settings.sign_in_confirm.body.note: Body of that dialog: starting Radient sign-in ends the current connection before the browser opens, and if the user abandons sign-in they must connect to their computer again. State the consequence plainly; do not promise the connection comes back.

mobile.settings.sign_in_confirm.confirm.note: Confirm button of that dialog; it starts Radient sign-in. One or two words, sentence case.

mobile.settings.account.route_radient.note: Second line of the Settings account card when the active connection runs through the user's Radient tunnel. Radient is the product name. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.account.route_direct.note: Second line of the Settings account card when the phone talks to a computer directly. {baseUrl} is the computer's web address; keep it unchanged and left-to-right. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.status.no_connection.note: Connection status word, in the Settings status pill and the account card, when no computer has been chosen yet. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.status.not_connected.note: Value of the Settings Status row when the chosen computer refused the connection. Short pill text; no final full stop.

mobile.settings.status.offline.note: Value of the Settings Status row when the live stream to the computer is down. One word if the language allows; no final full stop.

mobile.settings.status.not_answering.note: Value of the Settings Status row when the computer is reachable but not responding. Matches the relay's "Not answering" wording; no final full stop.

mobile.settings.status.connected.note: Value of the Settings Status row when the live stream to the computer is healthy. One word if the language allows; no final full stop.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.stream_idle.note: Value of the Diagnostics "Stream" row when no live stream has started. Lower-case diagnostic word, shown in a monospace line; one word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.stream_conne.note: Value of the Diagnostics "Stream" row when the stream is being opened. Lower-case diagnostic word, shown in a monospace line; one word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.stream_live.note: Value of the Diagnostics "Stream" row when the stream is healthy. Lower-case diagnostic word, shown in a monospace line; one word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.stream_degra.note: Value of the Diagnostics "Stream" row when the stream is open but not answering. Lower-case diagnostic word, shown in a monospace line; one word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.diagnostics.stream_offli.note: Value of the Diagnostics "Stream" row when the stream is down. Lower-case diagnostic word, shown in a monospace line; one word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.account.app_name.note: The product name, used only to derive the avatar initials when the account has no name and no computer is listed. Never translated: keep it exactly as is, in Latin script.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.not_saved.note: Status line in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it), under the saved address, when the relay password is not stored on the phone.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.kept_secure.note: Status line in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it), under the saved address, when both are stored. "Secure store" is the platform's encrypted storage for secrets.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.edit.note: Small button in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it) that opens the saved tunnel's address and password for editing. One word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.test_again.note: Small button in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it) that re-tests the saved tunnel without opening the form. While the test runs it shows "Testing…". No final full stop.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.remove.note: Small button in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it) that asks to forget the saved tunnel on this phone, and the confirm button of that dialog. Removes it from this phone only. One word, no final full stop.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.password_plac.note: Placeholder inside the empty relay-password field in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it). No final full stop.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.runtime_title.note: Title of an information box in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it) on a build (for example the web preview) that has no secure storage. "It" is the tunnel. No final full stop.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.runtime_body.note: Body of the same information box in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it). "Keystore"/"secure store" are the platform's encrypted storage for secrets.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.before_saving.note: Help line under Save/Cancel in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it), shown until a test succeeds (Save stays disabled until then).

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.remove_title.note: Title of the confirmation dialog in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it). A question; keep the question mark.

mobile.settings.own_tunnel.remove_body.note: Body of the same confirmation dialog in the "Your own tunnel" section of Settings (the saved own-tunnel: edit it, test it again, remove it): says what removing does and does not affect.
